description: REPLICA built in the late 1980s by the firm of Felice Gonalba for the Fondazione Ansaldo using an original engine propeller and radiators; displayed in the arrivals area at Genova-Sestri; the SVA was built at the Ansaldo yard at Borzoli and flew D'Annunzio's Vienna leaflet raid and the Rome-Tokyo flight
aliases: SVA; SVA.5; SVA-5; Ansaldo SVA; SVA5
